producer: kernel/harness.py, kernel/experiment.py, kernel/k2_eval.py, kernel/k4_eval.py, kernel/v3.py, analysis/q2_floor.py, analysis/q2_dirsig*.py, analysis/q2_linkfilt*.py, analysis/q2_l16.py, analysis/q2_l5*.py
regime_detail: D (one file, 1,000 rows) and DxR (a scenario's five replicates pooled, 5,000 rows); k2_dev: D+K replayed from AB-07; l5_*: D+I (ledger on the 800 observational rows of obs_int files, released single-target rows as evidence)

controls.columns_shuffled: always (engines see canonical column order: sorted by value hash)
controls.supplier: none (data only), except k2_dev: replay of AB-07's recorded gpt-4o tier replies

orientation_rule: undecided pairs oriented at random with a per-file seed, crc32(file name) (the AB-01 expectation rule)

metric_defs.precision_half: DV-1 precision of the half-coverage view (claims in order of calibrated probability, ties together)
metric_defs.ece: expected calibration error of calibrated DV-1 probabilities (10 equal-width bins)
metric_defs.missed_share: share of true links with no adjacency claim
